Database.//: When true (default), each instance applies pending EF migrations at startup under a PostgreSQL advisory lock that serializes concurrent replicas. Set to false to have a dedicated deployment migration step own schema changes; instances then verify the schema is current and fail closed if migrations are pending.

PublicBooking.//: Public website booking intake (POST /api/public/booking-requests). Disabled until configured.

ZocdocWebhooks.//: Trusted route-to-tenant mappings. WebhookSecret values must come from secret-backed environment variables.

StripeWebhooks.//: EndpointSecret must be injected from a secret store. Accounts are trusted connected-account-to-tenant mappings.

ServiceBus.//: Website booking returns 503 when empty. Verified Zocdoc webhooks remain durable in the inbox until the broker returns.
